newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank injects T$7.885 bln in funds.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank injects T$7.885 bln in funds.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank on Wednesday injected T$7.885 billion worth of funds into the banking system through open market operations, a central bank official said.

The bank, operating through finance companies authorised to issue commercial paper, bought T$7.885 billion in approved securities instruments offered by financial institutions with yields of between 5.500 and 5.625 percent, the official said.
The institutions have the option of repurchasing the instruments between seven and 20 days from now, the official said.
